Hi! I’m Ignacio, an undergraduate studying Electrical Engineering at University of California, Santa Barbara. I’m passionate about hardware design, quantum computing, and turning ideas into practical, well-designed projects.

Right now, I’m exploring a 2.4 GHz band-pass filter and building my skills in AWR MWO Cadence, KiCad, and Python. Outside the classroom, you can usually find me in my research lab shadowing my mentor or solving rubix cudes in my dorm.

Take a look at my recent work on the bandpass-filter-project page, or feel free to reach out—I’d love to connect!
